text: FDA granted accelerated approval on Nov 5 to subcutaneous amivantamab (Rybrevant Faspro) for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. On Oct 26 it approved talazoparib plus enzalutamide for HRR-mutated metastatic prostate cancer.

judge.comment: Two FDA approvals verified on the FDA notification page per the tracker digest; neutral, factual wording.

factChecks.claim: FDA accelerated approval of subcutaneous amivantamab (Rybrevant Faspro) on Nov 5 for recurrent or metastatic HNSCC
Oct 26 approval of talazoparib plus enzalutamide for HRR-mutated metastatic prostate cancer

text: Russian refining damage, two readings. Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% of capacity disabled (July 2026). IEA: losses "more than 20%" at peak; Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3–6%.

judge.comment: Presents both sides with attribution, no adjudication. The IEA and Reuters figures have no as-of date in the tracker data, so a human should confirm dates before posting.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were more than 20% at peak
factChecks.source: russian-fuel-crisis unresolved dispute; as-of date not given

factChecks.claim: Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3–6%
factChecks.source: russian-fuel-crisis unresolved dispute; as-of date not given

text: Paraguay's Congress has removed President Santiago Peña in an impeachment tied to the Ueno Bank crisis. The Senate removal vote was 44–0. About 3M Ueno clients remain locked out of their accounts.

judge.comment: Significant governance event, figures taken directly from tracker KPIs and event data.

factChecks.claim: Congress removed President Peña in impeachment after Ueno Bank crisis

factChecks.source: paraguay-pena-impeachment KPI: Ueno clients locked out

text: How many Hezbollah fighters have been killed in Lebanon? Israel/IDF estimates put it at 1,700–2,500. Hezbollah sources say 1,000+. The Lebanese health ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 Mar and gives no combatant split.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed and not adjudicated. The tracker notes Hezbollah publishes no totals, so its figure comes from 'sources'.

factChecks.claim: Lebanese ministry total 4,386 since 2 Mar, no combatant split
